summary: Tested three new features on tenant site /p/pv_c3b797fcdafc58d4e70e320f: (1) counting numbers, (2) live charts, (3) location map. Backend GET /public/templates/{key} returns address+phone correctly for all 8 industries. Template full-preview panel (from /templates page) requires admin auth so canvas variant matrix across 8 templates could NOT be directly re-verified this round; main agent's pre-check + code (VARIANTS[seed%10] and VARIANTS[(seed+4)%10]) is deterministic and template-key-hashed so pair uniqueness by industry is code-correct. On the tenant site: ambient-backdrop=0, industry-vitals renders 2 industry-charts (variants ['bars','candles']) + 1 industry-map, all three canvases show pixel changes between 800ms samples (proving live animation), 7 counters tagged with data-cm-num all preserve final values (including $, comma-grouping, +, /5, etc.), mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow and canvases still animate, prefers-reduced-motion produces static single-frame canvases (sum unchanged between samples). One CRITICAL functional bug and one CRITICAL data bug found (see below).

ui_bugs.issue: Counter re-animates on the FIRST scroll-in but NOT on subsequent scroll-out/scroll-in cycles. Cycle 1: early='$37' final='$39' (counted up). Cycle 2 AND Cycle 3: early=final='$39' — runCount was not invoked again on re-entry. The requirement explicitly states 're-animates from a low value up to its final value EACH time'. Root cause: needs investigation — likely the IntersectionObserver isn't firing 'isIntersecting=true' again, possibly because the element never crosses back below the 0.35 threshold when scrolled with scrollIntoView({block:'center'}), or the observer callback coalesces rapid transitions. Consider lowering threshold to 0 and gating runCount by a wasOutside flag that flips when isIntersecting=false is seen.

On the tenant site the industry-map-address renders the workspace DESCRIPTION ('The live master workspace. Every design, motion and content change made here applies instantly to its template and to every active tenant.') because PublicPreview.tsx line 159 falls back to `site.app.description` when `site.app.address` is missing. A multi-sentence description shown as an address is misleading. Fix: pass `site.app.address || ''` (LocationMap already falls back to 'Address on request') or fall back to the industry template default address returned by /public/templates/{key}.

action_items: Fix ContentMotion counter re-animation so it re-triggers on EVERY re-entry, not just the first (add wasOutside gate or use lower threshold + hysteresis).

Fix PublicPreview.tsx line 159: stop falling back to site.app.description for the map address; use the industry template default address (via /public/templates/{key}) or an empty string so LocationMap shows its own 'Address on request' fallback.

OPTIONAL: verify variant PAIR uniqueness by opening the full template preview panel for dental/hvac/legal/saas/healthcare/restaurant/fitness/retail while logged in as admin — code hashes deterministically so this should already work, but a UI re-verification would close the loop.
critical_code_review_comments: IndustryVitals.tsx useLoop passes `deps` array to useEffect but exhaustive-deps disabled implicitly; ref is captured OK. Fine.
IndustryVitals canvas repeatedly calls getImageData internally? No — only draw calls. Console warns about willReadFrequently but that's from my test harness sampling, not app code.

ContentMotion runs tag() twice at 60ms and 700ms; each call creates a NEW IntersectionObserver assigned to `counters` and the previous observer is never disconnected (memory leak / duplicate callbacks). Recommend disconnecting the previous counters observer before assigning a new one, or gating the second tag() to not recreate the observer.

ContentMotion counter observer uses threshold 0.35 with no rootMargin — combined with runCount only firing on isIntersecting=true and no explicit reset when leaving, this likely explains the failed re-animation on cycles 2+. Consider tracking last-seen state per element.
PublicPreview.tsx address fallback to description is a semantic bug (description text is not an address).

rca of the issue: Counter re-animation bug: ContentMotion.tsx uses `new IntersectionObserver((entries) => entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) runCount(...) }), { threshold: 0.35 })`. IntersectionObserver only invokes the callback when the intersection ratio CROSSES a threshold. If between two callback fires the element toggles from >=0.35 to <0.35 and back to >=0.35, some browsers coalesce and deliver only the final entry (still isIntersecting=true, no state change) so no callback fires. First entry works because it is the initial observation. Fix: keep a per-element `wasOutside` flag set to true whenever isIntersecting=false is observed, and only call runCount when isIntersecting=true AND wasOutside is true; then reset wasOutside=false. Also disconnect the previous counters observer before creating a new one at the 700ms retag. Map address bug: PublicPreview.tsx line 159 `address={site.app.address || site.app.description}` — the OR fallback to description leaks non-address prose into the map card.
